{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2oa
|version1= 1.62

|game2= tkoh
|version2= 1.00

|game3= arma3
|version3= 0.50

|arg= global

|gr1= Positions

|descr= Returns the position of the object other units can aim to.

|s1= [[aimPos]]  unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Position#PositionASL|PositionASL]]

|x1= <sqf>_aimPos = aimPos player;</sqf>

|x2= '''''aimPosVisual''''' equivalent:<sqf>private _aimPosVisual = AGLToASL unitAimPositionVisual player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[eyePos]] [[getPosASL]] [[weaponDirection]] [[unitAimPosition]] [[unitAimPositionVisual]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Waffle SS.
|timestamp= 20150707211900
|text= Generally returns the center position of the object (middle of the geometry, not the model's [0,0,0]).
}}

{{Note
|user= Sa-Matra
|timestamp= 20230327123311
|text= This command uses "zamerny" memory point which is hardcoded name in the engine. If memory point is not present then geometry LOD bounding center is used (according to dedmen)
}}
